small_margin_rule: if any primary half gain is < 1 pp, a PASS is INCONCLUSIVE
title: Signal-rank liquidity guard: keep signals in the top third of the pair's own recent signal candles (momentum, cs_aro, cs_aro_all3k)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), seed 1 weights for the reversion arms, momentum model-free. Nothing adopted.
why: preregistration_liqnz.json (traded-candle median, 5x): momentum PASS (PROVISIONAL, +10.77/+3.32 n.s.), cs_aro and cs_aro_all3k FAIL late (-1.39, -4.09); refusals there fell mostly on SOL/XRP, i.e. partly a pair filter. Offline (full-sample, lookahead) the within-pair top tercile of SIGNAL candles held 77% of cs_aro's P&L, both halves positive. This is that tercile made causal: rank each signal against the same pair's previous signal candles.
definition: signal candle = a row of the book's own entry mask (before the volume > 0 / rvol checks); history = the pair's previous K such rows with quote volume > 0 (current row excluded) inside the backtest dataframe (4096-bar startup + test window); keep where quote volume > the history's 2/3 quantile; fewer than K prior traded signals -> kept (no filter)
parameter_choice: From the observe-mode probes (st_g24_mom_srprobe, cs_aro_srprobe: 15/15 folds hash-identical to the s4k controls) and refusal shares on the controls' trades only (no P&L read): traded signal rows per pair per 90 days ~710 (momentum, consecutive rows) vs ~82 (reversion), so K = ~3 weeks of signals (160 / 20). Cut q = 1/3 refuses only 4.3% / 8.3% / 8.4% of control trades (near-inert, not registered); q = 2/3 refuses 20.8% / 25.3% / 26.2%, with 2.2% / 12.5% / 12.1% of control trades lacking K prior signals (kept).

arms.cs_aro_liqsr: NNNC_CS_ARO (startup 4096, cs_aro's weights via MODEL_TRAINED_WITH) + LIQUIDITY_GUARD {signals 20, quantile 2/3}

controls.cs_aro_all3k_liqsr: cs_aro_all3k_s4k (all from earlier pre-registrations, already run)

probes: st_g24_mom_srprobe, cs_aro_srprobe (observe mode, run before registration): 15/15 folds trades_hash-identical to their s4k controls
code: utils/LiquidityGuardMixin.py (signal-rank mode, observe flag, FT_LIQ_GUARD_DUMP; utils/tests/test_liquidity_guard.py); SimpleTrigger/SimpleTrigger_BreakoutGbb_MomExit_G24_{SRProbe,LiqSR}.py; NNNC/NNNC_CS_ARO_{SRPROBE,LIQSR}.py, NNNC/NNNC_CS_ARO_ALL3K_LIQSR.py
instrument: all 15 records per arm; each arm run with FT_LIQ_GUARD_DUMP (its own signal rows, thresholds, keep flags); per arm: >= 99% of its trades' signal candles (the row before the entry open, in the trade's own fold dump) have keep = True; >= 10% of its control's trades' signal candles fail the arm's threshold in the same dump; trades in both halves; 0 position adds. Fail -> that question INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read
